# LeadSnipper

> LeadSnipper is a cold email and outbound infrastructure platform for SaaS teams and agencies, built on AWS SES, with tools for deliverability, email warmup, campaign automation, and lead sourcing.

LeadSnipper helps teams send cold outbound email at scale without damaging sender reputation, by combining managed AWS SES infrastructure, automated email warmup, domain/DNS setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and campaign tooling in one platform. It is built for SaaS founders, growth teams, and outbound agencies who want lower per-email cost than tools like Smartlead, Instantly, Lemlist, Mailshake, or Apollo, without sacrificing deliverability.

- [Email Warmup](https://leadsnipper.com/email-warmup): Automated inbox warmup tool to protect sender reputation before scaling outreach.
- [Email Deliverability](https://leadsnipper.com/email-deliverability): Deliverability monitoring and domain reputation tools.
- [AI Cold Email Generator](https://leadsnipper.com/ai-cold-email-generator): AI-assisted cold email copywriting tool.
